official.deadline_note: Applications open 27 July 2026 and close 1 October 2027. Course application deadlines for the chosen intake also apply, and Curtin may cease offering the scholarship earlier once all places are filled or if the Letter of Offer is not accepted by its due date.
official.application_cycle: Courses commencing 2027 or 2028 at a Curtin Western Australian campus
official.status_note: Official page states Status: Open, with applications open 27/07/2026 and applications close 1/10/2027. Curtin reserves the right to cease offering the scholarship if the offer is not accepted by the due date or when all places are filled.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Provides 40% of the tuition fee of your Course, credited for up to 4 years for an undergraduate degree course OR maximum of 2 years for a Masters degree by Coursework (Scholarship term), as a tuition fee credit against all unit(s) enrolled within the course within the scholarship term.
official.funding_period: % of tuition fee for the scholarship term
benefits: Provides 40% of the tuition fee of your Course, credited for up to 4 years for an undergraduate degree course OR maximum of 2 years for a Masters degree by Coursework (Scholarship term), as a tuition fee credit against all unit(s) enrolled within the course within the scholarship term.
Will be credited to recipient's fee account after census date of the first study period.
Only covers tuition fees and does not cover any other international student expense.
eligibility: International, fee-paying, non-sponsored students of any nationality except Australian.
Are enrolled in a Curtin undergraduate degree course OR a Master degree by coursework.
Will be studying at a Curtin Western Australian campus (WA Campus) commencing in 2027 or 2028.
Achieved a Course-Weighted Average (CWA) of 95% or equivalent scores in your most recent and eligible course of study, as determined by Curtin University.

Are not enrolled in: (1) Not-for-Degree Exchange or Study Abroad program (2) campus transfer from a Curtin global campus (3) a recognised joint program at a Curtin Transnational Partner Location outside Australia.
Will not be enrolled in one of the courses excluded from this Scholarship program.
requirements: Must maintain enrolment as an international full fee paying and non-sponsored student during the Scholarship.
Must maintain an academic status of 'Good Standing' and a minimum CWA of 70% from the second study period onwards, in every study period across the Scholarship term.
Must maintain full-time enrolment in each study period during the Scholarship term; underloading does not extend the Scholarship term.
Must not be on Leave of Absence (LoA) during the Scholarship term; LoA study periods still count toward the Scholarship term.
Must not be Withdrawn or AWOL from Curtin.
Must not receive, hold or be awarded any other Curtin or Australian government scholarship while in receipt of this Scholarship.
Must abide by Curtin's policies and procedures, Student Charter and not be found guilty of serious misconduct.
Must pay the full Deposit amount set out in the Letter of Offer for the first study period of the Course to accept the scholarship offer.
documents: Certified copies of academic transcripts for all previous qualifications.
Certified copies of descriptions of the grading system for all previous qualifications.
Certified copies of award certificates for all previous qualifications.
Certified copies of evidence of English language proficiency (e.g. IELTS Academic, TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic results).
Official English translations of any document issued in a language other than English.
An employment verification letter from your employer and a detailed CV where the course requires work experience or is entered on that basis.
selection_criteria: Achieved a Course-Weighted Average (CWA) of 95% or equivalent scores in your most recent and eligible course of study, as determined by Curtin University. This is determined by Curtin University and may change without notice.
coverage: Only covers tuition fees and does not cover any other international student expense.
40% of the tuition fee of the Course, applied as a tuition fee credit against all unit(s) enrolled within the course within the Scholarship term.
application_method: There is no separate scholarship application required.
Students are invited to apply for the Curtin course through one of Curtin University registered education agents OR apply directly to Curtin online.
All qualifying applications to Curtin are automatically assessed for the John Curtin Global Excellence Scholarship.
Global Admissions will assess each application accordingly and issue a supplementary letter, along with a Letter of Offer, to confirm whether the applicant has been successful.
official.application_route: Apply for a Curtin course directly online or through a Curtin registered education agent; all qualifying applications are automatically assessed, with no separate scholarship application.
official.study_mode: Full-time enrolment must be maintained in each study period of the scholarship term.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to international students of any nationality except Australian; the student must be an international, fee-paying, non-sponsored student.
official.international_eligibility: Yes. The scholarship is open to international, fee-paying, non-sponsored students of any nationality except Australian, studying at a Curtin Western Australian campus.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Eligible courses are all undergraduate degrees excluding the Bachelor of Science (Medical Radiation Science), Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery, Bachelor of Science (Advanced Nursing), Bachelor of Science (Paramedicine) and Bachelor of Science (Oral Health Therapy); and all Master degrees by coursework excluding the Master of Taxation, Master of Dietetics, Master of Midwifery, Master of Occupational Therapy, Master of Social Work (Qualifying), Master of Clinical Physiotherapy, Master of Nursing Practice, Master of Psychology (Professional), Master of Clinical Psychology and Master of Psychology (Clinical). Faculties covered: Business and Law, Health Sciences, Humanities, and Science and Engineering (including WASM). Not-for-Degree Exchange, Study Abroad, campus transfers from a Curtin global campus, and recognised joint programs at a Curtin Transnational Partner Location outside Australia are also ineligible.
official.duration: Credited for up to 4 years for an undergraduate degree course OR maximum of 2 years for a Masters degree by Coursework (Scholarship term).
official.description: Through the John Curtin Global Excellence Scholarship, eligible students will receive 40% off the tuition fee for the duration of the course. Curtin University awards this prestigious scholarship to students who have demonstrated exceptional academic performance and a commitment to excellence in their studies.
official.program_type: University merit scholarship - international tuition fee waiver
official.english_requirement: The scholarship page sets no separate English requirement; admission to a Curtin course requires Curtin's published minimum English standard, which the English proficiency tests table lists as IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with no band below 6.0, TOEFL iBT overall 81 (tests taken from June 2026) or 79 (tests taken prior to June 2026), or PTE Academic overall 58. The test must have been undertaken within two years of application, and results from multiple tests cannot be combined. Some courses set higher English requirements.

not_confirmed: A monetary award amount in a currency: the official pages publish only a 40% tuition-fee percentage, so no currency figure exists.

applicant_utility.summary: This is an automatic tuition discount, not a scholarship competition: Global Admissions considers you the moment it assesses your Curtin course application, and success arrives as a supplementary letter alongside your Letter of Offer. The benefit is a 40% tuition-fee credit applied after the census date of your first study period, capped at four years for an undergraduate degree or two years for a coursework Master's, and it only applies at a Curtin Western Australian campus. Because the award covers tuition alone, you must separately fund the Letter of Offer deposit, the remaining 60% of tuition, Perth living costs, Overseas Student Health Cover and visa charges. The 95% Course-Weighted Average threshold is Curtin's own calculation of your transcript and may change without notice, so a borderline average is a genuine risk.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Self-funded international applicants of any nationality except Australian, with a 95% Course-Weighted Average, who are targeting 2027 or 2028 entry at Curtin Perth or Kalgoorlie and whose course is not on the exclusion list.
application_readiness_checklist: Check your intended course against the published exclusion list before applying; excluded courses cannot receive the scholarship regardless of your grades.
Have your most recent qualification's transcript and grading-scale description ready so Curtin can convert your results into a Course-Weighted Average against the 95% threshold.
Get every transcript, grading descriptor and award certificate certified, with a certified English translation if it is not already in English.
Arrange valid English evidence (IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0, TOEFL iBT 81, or PTE Academic 58) taken within the last two years, or a Curtin-recognised equivalent.
Budget for the full deposit shown in your Letter of Offer plus OSHC, visa costs and first-semester living expenses, since the credit only lands after census date.
Apply for your course as early as possible rather than waiting near 1 October 2027, since places can fill and the offer must be accepted by the Letter of Offer due date.
common_rejection_risks: A Course-Weighted Average below the 95% threshold as calculated by Curtin, which reserves the right to change the threshold and its equivalence rules without notice.

Applying into an excluded course such as the Bachelor of Medicine/Surgery, Medical Radiation Science, Advanced Nursing, Paramedicine or Oral Health Therapy, or one of the excluded coursework masters including Taxation, Dietetics, Midwifery, Occupational Therapy, Social Work, Clinical Physiotherapy, Nursing Practice and the professional/clinical Psychology masters.
Holding another Curtin or Australian government scholarship, or being sponsored, which triggers revocation of the award.
Failing to accept the Letter of Offer or enrol by the date specified, or deferring beyond the study period and year that was offered.

After enrolment, dropping below full-time study, taking Leave of Absence, losing 'Good Standing', or falling under a 70% CWA from the second study period onward, each of which can revoke continuation.

Being a Not-for-Degree Exchange or Study Abroad student, a campus transfer from a Curtin global campus, or enrolled in a recognised joint program at a Curtin Transnational Partner Location outside Australia.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The remaining 60% of tuition fees, living costs and accommodation in Perth, Overseas Student Health Cover, student visa charges, flights, and the deposit payable on accepting the Letter of Offer - the award is a tuition credit only.
document_audit: Every page of each transcript and award certificate must be certified - signed, dated and bearing an official stamp or seal from an authorised Curtin representative or agent, a Global Curtin Admissions staff member, the issuing institution, a Justice of the Peace, a Commissioner for Oaths or a notary public.
Translations must be prepared by an accredited translator or a person with official authority at the issuing institution; translations done by the applicant or an agent are not accepted.
Include a description of the grading system with your transcripts, otherwise Curtin cannot translate your results into the CWA it measures against the 95% threshold.
Provide evidence such as a marriage certificate, deed poll or affidavit if your documents show a name change or any discrepancy in your details.
Certify and submit English evidence with the application rather than later, since the qualification must also satisfy Curtin's admission English standard, not just the scholarship.
alerts: Places are finite: Curtin may stop offering the scholarship once all places are filled, and can withdraw it if you do not accept by the due date on your Letter of Offer.
The credit is applied to your fee account only after the census date of your first study period, so you must carry the deposit and first tuition payment yourself until then.

The scholarship cannot be withdrawn or refunded in cash, cannot be transferred to a Curtin campus or partner outside Western Australia or to another university, and is lost if you defer beyond the study period and year offered.
If your citizenship changes during the scholarship period, Curtin will apply the scholarship only to the units you complete as an international student.
Changing courses mid-term triggers a reassessment, and if your new course does not meet the criteria the scholarship is revoked and outstanding tuition becomes payable.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Lodge a Curtin course application directly online or through a registered education agent; Global Admissions assesses every qualifying application automatically and confirms the outcome in a supplementary letter sent with the Letter of Offer, so there is no scholarship form to submit.
